# Markdown

Renders Markdown written by an AI, also while it streams in. Headings, lists, quotes, tables, inline code and
code blocks follow the theme; code blocks are CodeBlocks with the language and a copy button.

**Security**: raw HTML in the text is always shown as text, never rendered. Links only work for http, https,
mailto and relative addresses (other protocols such as `javascript:` are shown as plain text), and links to
other sites open in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Images are not loaded unless `allowImage`
allows their address.

**Interaction**: links have the focus ring; a wide table scrolls horizontally inside its frame and can then be
focused with `Tab` and scrolled with the arrow keys. While `streaming`, a static cursor marks the end and the
element is `aria-busy`. Rendered on the server, it outputs the text as plain text and switches to Markdown after
hydration.

**Category**: AI · **Common uses**: AI replies, streamed answers, generated summaries and documentation

## Import

```ts
import { Markdown } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Pass the Markdown text. Headings, lists, task lists, tables, quotes, inline code and code blocks follow the theme;
code blocks show their language and a copy button.

```tsx
import { Markdown } from 'vellum-ui'

const RICH = `## Release checklist

The build passed on all three platforms. Before tagging:

- [x] Update the \`CHANGELOG\`
- [x] Run the end-to-end tests
- [ ] Ask **Maya** to review the migration notes

| Step | Owner | Time |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Freeze | Alex | 10 min |
| Tag and publish | Sam | 25 min |

\`\`\`ts
export const version = '2.4.0'
\`\`\`

> Docs are at [the project site](https://example.com/docs), see the [contributing guide](/docs/contributing).

---

Ping the team when the tag is live.`

export function Basic() {
  return <Markdown content={RICH} />
}
```

## States

### Streaming reply

While the reply streams in, set `streaming`: half-written syntax is shown as if finished, and a cursor marks the
end. `typewriter` smooths out chunks that arrive in bursts.

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  Inline,
  Markdown,
  readSSE,
  type ServerSentEvent,
  Stack,
  useStream,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface FakeStreamOptions {
  /** Aborts the stream, like the `signal` of `fetch`. */
  readonly signal?: AbortSignal
  /** Characters per event. */
  readonly chunk?: number
  /** Milliseconds between events. */
  readonly interval?: number
  /** Fails with this error after this many characters. */
  readonly failAfter?: number
}

const DEMO_REPLY = `Here is a short plan for the launch:

1. **Freeze the scope** on Monday and share the list with the team.
2. Run the release checklist; anything \`blocked\` moves to the next sprint.
3. Write the announcement — keep it under 200 words.

> Ship small, ship often.

Let me know if you want a timeline as a table.`

function fakeSSE(text: string, options: FakeStreamOptions = {}): Response {
  const { chunk = 3, interval = 30, signal, failAfter } = options
  if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason
  const encoder = new TextEncoder()
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  let sent = 0
  const body = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
    start(controller) {
      const next = () => {
        if (failAfter !== undefined && sent >= failAfter) {
          controller.error(new Error('The connection was reset'))
          return
        }
        if (sent >= text.length) {
          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode('data: [DONE]\n\n'))
          controller.close()
          return
        }
        const delta = text.slice(sent, sent + chunk)
        sent += delta.length
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ delta })}\n\n`))
        timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
      }
      timer = setTimeout(next, interval)
    },
    cancel() {
      clearTimeout(timer)
    },
  })
  return new Response(body, { headers: { 'content-type': 'text/event-stream' } })
}

const appendDelta = (text: string, e: ServerSentEvent) =>
  e.data === '[DONE]' ? text : text + (JSON.parse(e.data) as { delta: string }).delta

export function Streaming() {
  const reply = useStream({
    request: (signal) =>
      readSSE(fakeSSE(DEMO_REPLY, { signal, chunk: 4, interval: 40 }), { signal }),
    initial: '',
    reduce: appendDelta,
  })
  const streaming = reply.status === 'streaming'
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Inline gap={2}>
        {streaming ? (
          <Button onClick={reply.stop}>Stop</Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => reply.start()}>
            Generate
          </Button>
        )}
      </Inline>
      <Markdown content={reply.value} streaming={streaming} typewriter />
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Untrusted content

Raw HTML is always shown as text, and links with other protocols such as `javascript:` are plain text. Images are
not loaded by default; `allowImage` decides by address (here only the `assets.example.com` host).

```tsx
import { Markdown } from 'vellum-ui'

const UNTRUSTED = `Raw HTML is shown as text: <img src="x" onerror="alert(1)"> <script>alert(1)</script>

Only safe links work: [docs](https://example.com/docs), [mail](mailto:team@example.com), [bad](javascript:alert(1)).

![Chart of last week](https://images.example.com/chart.png)

![Team logo](https://assets.example.com/logo.png)`

export function Untrusted() {
  return (
    <Markdown
      content={UNTRUSTED}
      allowImage={(src) => new URL(src, 'https://app.example.com').host === 'assets.example.com'}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `string` | The Markdown text (CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks). It can grow while the reply streams in. | — | Yes |
| `streaming` | `boolean` | More content is coming: half-written syntax is shown as if finished (`**bold` is already bold, the text of a link appears before its address), only the part that is still growing is parsed again, and a cursor marks the end. When it becomes `false`, everything is rendered as final. | `false` | No |
| `typewriter` | `boolean` | Types new content out at a steady pace while `streaming`, instead of showing each chunk as it arrives. Off with "reduce motion". | `false` | No |
| `allowImage` | `(src: string) => boolean` | Decides whether an image is loaded, by its address (only http, https and relative addresses are passed in). By default no image is loaded: an address written by an AI can send data from the conversation to another site. Images that are not loaded are shown as their alternative text, linked to the address. | — | No |
| `sources` | `readonly SourceItem[]` | The sources the reply cites. With them, `[1]` (or `[^1]`) in the text is shown as a Citation of the first source, with a popover on hover and focus; numbers without a source stay as text. Show the list itself with Sources. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### SourceItem

One source of Sources and Citation.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | Stable key; the index is used when omitted. | — | No |
| `title` | `string` | Title of the page or document. | — | Yes |
| `url` | `string` | Address. Only http, https, mailto and relative addresses become links (others are shown as text); the site name is taken from it. | — | No |
| `description` | `string` | A short excerpt or summary. | — | No |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | An icon for the site, provided by the application (such as an image from its own server). Remote site icons are never loaded automatically. | — | No |
